_doc: Budgets for scripts/flow/flow.py. Each metric: limit (FAIL past it), target (WARN past it,
PASS within), cmp ('<=' or '>='), unit, why. 'baseline' is the last known-good measurement
(python scripts/check.py --update-baseline); a metric that is >10% worse than baseline WARNs
even when it is inside the target. Rationale and sources: docs/budgets.md.
Operating point: 8 channels selected from a 256-slot ADC mux at 19.53 kHz/slot, clock = slot
rate = 5 MHz (200 ns), sky130_fd_sc_hd. TT's own GDS flow (LibreLane) is the sign-off for area
and timing; these are pre-layout estimates.

lint_errors.why: TT's flow runs Verilator lint; errors stop the GDS build

tests_failed.why: model, lossy RTL, rANS RTL, TT top (implemented modes), lossy gate-level

lossy_cell_area_um2.why: limit: fits TT 8x2 (16 tiles x 18,036 um^2 x 60% density); target: 4x2 (8 tiles), = 0.011 mm^2/channel

lossy_area_per_ch_mm2.why: published neural compression ASICs: 0.004-0.03 mm^2/ch at 130-180 nm (docs/budgets.md)

top_utilisation.why: whole TT design cell area / tiles in info.yaml; TT's default PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT is 60, users report up to ~80

setup_slack_ss_tt_clk_ns.why: TT CLOCK_PERIOD (src/config.json; must be 200 ns, docs/constraints.md D2/C-TIM-3) at the slow corner (ss 100C 1.60 V); target keeps 30% of the period for wires and clock skew (pre-layout)

setup_slack_ss_op_clk_ns.why: operating clock 200 ns at the slow corner; target 30%

hold_slack_ff_ns.why: fast corner (ff -40C 1.95 V), ideal clock: real hold is fixed by CTS/resizer in TT's flow

lossy_power_uw.why: Neuralink-derived (docs/constraints.md D4, C-PWR-1): < 10 mW for 1024 ch incl. radio = ~9.8 uW/ch; compressor share limit 5 uW/ch, target 2 uW/ch, x 8 channels

core_power_uw.why: C-PWR-1 at system level: nlc_core (config, slot selector, encoder, output FIFO) at the real 256-slot interface, real data (T-PWR-2)

core_power_idle_uw.why: C-PWR-2 at system level: nlc_core configured, enable = 0, ADC stream running (T-PWR-2)

layout_power_uw.why: T-PWR-3: routed TT design (clock tree, wires, repair buffers, pin glue) on real data at the operating frame rate; same budget as C-PWR-1 (docs/budgets.md)

layout_power_idle_uw.why: T-PWR-3 idle: routed design, enable = 0, ADC strobes running (C-PWR-2)

layout_core_power_uw.why: T-PWR-3 core share of the routed design (nlc_core and its clock subtrees; without the TT pin glue and the shared clock trunk): what an implant would carry, compare with T-PWR-2 core_power_uw

power_worst_uw.why: C-PWR-5: LFSR (incompressible) data must stay inside the C-PWR-1 limit

lossy_power_density_mw_cm2.why: AAMI implant limit ~40 mW/cm^2 (~2 C tissue heating); area = cell area / 60% density

radio_energy_ratio.why: compressor energy / radio energy it saves per sample (10 nJ/bit); must be << 1 to be worth it

bits_per_sample.why: 160 held-out challenge files (32-191); 2.087 at design time (old software model 2.118)

snr_median_db.why: median per-channel SNR, 160 held-out files; 18.0 dB at design time (a 32-file --quick run reads ~1.4 dB lower: subset variance)

latency_processing_us.why: C-LAT-1 derived bound (2026-10-10): transform look-ahead 36 frames + queue 8 frames = 44 x 51.2 us; the challenge's < 1 ms is read as throughput (C-IF-9). Measured (T-IF-1 monitors) as sample slot -> the last coder symbol that depends on the sample (transform look-ahead + per-channel FIFO lag + coder entry). Queue-only latency (push -> coder) is in the details.

latency_delivery_ms.why: C-LAT-2: sample slot -> last byte of its packet taken by the host; patent packet windows 10-40 ms

coverage_missing_bins.why: docs/testing.md 4.5: functional coverage bins not hit by the test/core regression (WARN only); list in the details

layout_utilisation.why: LibreLane stdcell area (incl. clock tree, repair/hold buffers, taps) / core area of the routed design; TT's placement density target is 60%, routing gets hard past ~80%

layout_hold_slack_ns.why: LibreLane worst hold slack over all corners of the routed design; clock-tree changes (F17) trade clock buffers against hold margin and hold buffers

layout_slew_violations_ss.why: T-FAN-1: pins over the sign-off max transition (0.75 ns) at ss with routed parasitics; not a TT precheck failure, but slow edges cost short-circuit power and hide high-fanout nets (layout_fanout.md)
